title: Coinbase Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: For Q1 2026 Coinbase reported USD 1.339 billion net revenue, USD 756 million transaction revenue, USD 584 million subscription and services revenue, a USD 394 million net loss, USD 183 million operating cash flow, and USD 248 million stock-based compensation expense.
summary: The SEC-filed Q1 2026 Form 10-Q confirms stablecoin growth and positive operating cash flow but also sharp transaction cyclicality, a GAAP loss, customer-asset custody obligations, revenue concentration, stock compensation, and a balance-sheet presentation that prevents a clean downside-aware per-share valuation bridge.
